observations:
Torah #51 is a tightly focused teaching on a single axis: falsehood (שקר) vs. truth (אמת), mapped onto distance-from-the-One vs. closeness-to-the-One. The four packages identified cover its complete conceptual vocabulary. No 3+-node bechina domain was found that forms an independent thematic family outside these four packages.

The teaching's argument runs in four moves:
  [Pkg 1 evil] שקר/מים מים/דמעות — the evil domain of falsehood, multiplicity, and tears
    →eitza→ 
  [Pkg 3 neutral] טהרה/בחירה/שמאל — the structural intermediary of purity/free will, through which evil takes hold and through which it can be rectified
    ←context— 
  [Pkg 2 neutral] שיש טהור/אחר הפעלה — the post-creation world of existence, where the question of truth/falsehood is relevant
    —goal→ 
  [Pkg 4 good] אמת/כלו אחד/עינים/השגחה — the positive domain of truth, oneness, and divine providence

The good/evil mirror structure is present but asymmetric: Package 1 (evil: שקר) is the direct mirror of Package 4 (good: אמת). They are the two opposing poles of the teaching's central axis. Package 3 (neutral: טהרה/בחירה) is the structural intermediary between them — a genuine neutral domain with no evil counterpart, since it describes the apparatus of free will itself.

New package check — three potential candidates were examined:

1. 'Pre-Creation State / Divine Unity' (קדם הבריאה, כלו אחד, אמת, כלו טוב, כלו קדש): These concepts are proposed as additions to Package 4 (אמת/השגחה). They do not form an independent package because the Torah does not develop the pre-creation state as a domain unto itself — it is invoked as the GOAL STATE that אמת leads toward. The pre-creation concepts are absorbed into the אמת/כלו אחד domain of Package 4.

2. 'Physiological Chain of Evil' (עכירת דמים, מרה שחורה, דמעות, עינים כהות): This chain (turbid blood → melancholy → tears → dim eyes) is described in the Torah's opening section. However, it is an eitza chain (each stage causes the next), NOT a bechina cluster (shared nature). The framework explicitly prohibits building packages from eitza chains. דמעות is already in Package 1 (bechina of שקר), and עינים is in Package 4 (bechina of השגחה). The physiological intermediaries (עכירת דמים, מרה שחורה) are eitza links only and do not form a package.

3. 'Tribal/Priestly Structure' (לוי, שמאל, טהרה, 'וְטִהַרְתָּ אֶת בְּנֵי לֵוִי'): Levi and שמאל are already in Package 3 as bechinot of טהרה. They are 2 nodes (plus טהרה as hub), fully absorbed into Package 3. No additional nodes specific to this domain appear in the Torah's bechina language that would require a separate package.
